attributes.name: Very cold
attributes.field_band_sentence: Dangerously cold for swimming — cold-water shock is a real risk. Wetsuits essential, stay close to shore.

attributes.name: Cold
attributes.field_band_sentence: Cold enough to take your breath away — keep swims short or wear a wetsuit.

attributes.name: Cool
attributes.field_band_sentence: Refreshing but chilly — fine for a quick swim on a hot day, cold for a long soak.

attributes.name: Pleasant
attributes.field_band_sentence: Comfortable swimming temperatures by mountain-lake standards.

attributes.name: Warm
attributes.field_band_sentence: Unusually warm for Tahoe — easy swimming, and worth savoring.

attributes.name: Crystal clear
attributes.field_band_sentence: Exceptional clarity — you can see far into the water. Classic Tahoe.

attributes.name: Clear
attributes.field_band_sentence: Clear water with good visibility for swimming and snorkeling.

attributes.name: Slightly cloudy
attributes.field_band_sentence: Some suspended sediment — visibility is reduced, which is common after wind, waves, or runoff.

attributes.name: Murky
attributes.field_band_sentence: Poor visibility from stirred-up sediment — swimming and sight-fishing will be limited today.
